source: Lenovo PSREF LOQ 15IRX9 (ports 1–8, 359.86 × 258.7 × 21.9–23.9 mm, 'No fingerprint reader', E-shutter) and PSREF product photos. Rear positions measured from the rear photo (about ±5 mm). Left/right side positions and the E-shutter position are estimates; verify on your unit. Other LOQ 15 generations (15IRH8, 15IAX9, 15ARP9…) have similar but not identical layouts.

ports.label: USB-A 5Gbps
ports.info: Rear USB-A port, good for a mouse or keyboard receiver.

ports.label: HDMI 2.1
ports.info: Connect an external monitor or TV, up to high refresh rates for gaming.
tips: Press Win + P to choose Duplicate or Extend.

ports.label: Ethernet (RJ-45)
ports.info: Wired network cable. Lower latency than Wi-Fi for online gaming.

ports.label: Charging light
ports.info: Status light next to the power connector. Shows whether the adapter is connected and the battery is charging.
tips: The exact colours and blink patterns are listed in the Lenovo user guide for your model.

ports.label: Power connector
ports.info: Slim-tip (rectangular) power connector for the Lenovo gaming adapter.
specs: Rapid Charge Pro: up to 50% in 30 min
tips: Use the supplied adapter for full gaming performance; USB-C charging is slower.

ports.label: USB-C 10Gbps (PD, DP)
ports.info: USB-C for data, a display, or charging the laptop.
specs: USB PD 65–100 W (140 W with Lenovo adapter)

ports.label: USB-A 5Gbps
ports.info: Side USB-A port for drives and accessories.

ports.label: Webcam E-shutter switch
ports.info: Electronic privacy switch: turns the webcam off completely.
tips: If the camera shows a black image, check this switch first.

ports.label: Power button (LOQ logo)
ports.info: Round LOQ-logo button, centred above the keyboard. Press to turn on or sleep. No fingerprint reader on this model.
tips: Hold for about 10 seconds to force a shutdown if the laptop freezes.

ports.label: Touchpad
ports.info: Buttonless multi-touch touchpad (75 × 120 mm), centred under the space bar rather than the laptop.

ports.label: Webcam (E-shutter)
ports.info: FHD 1080p or HD 720p webcam in the top bezel bump, with a dual-microphone array.
